scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/domain && npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/adapters && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build:runner-go
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w packages/domain && npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/adapters
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:runner-go
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently "npm run dev -w packages/domain" "npm run dev -w packages/shared" "npm run dev -w packages/adapters" "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web" "cd apps/runner-go && go run ./cmd/printops-runner run"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run typecheck:runner-go
